LandingPage.faq1Answer: Not at all. The Agent Factory provides a visual, drag-and-drop interface. You describe what you want your agent to do in natural language, pick a model, attach tools — and it works. Developers can also use our REST API and Python SDK for deeper integrations.
LandingPage.faq1Question: Do I need to write code to use apowerb?
LandingPage.faq2Answer: apowerb is multi-provider by design. We support Google Gemini, OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-3.5), Anthropic Claude, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more via LiteLLM. Bring your own API keys — we never store or access your model credentials in plaintext.
LandingPage.faq3Answer: Security is foundational. All API keys are AES-encrypted at rest. Knowledge bases are isolated per organization. We support SSO via Google, Microsoft Azure, GitHub, and LinkedIn. Enterprise plans include custom guardrails, on-premise deployment, and audit logs.
LandingPage.faq4Answer: Yes! The Marketplace lets you publish agents for the community. Others can discover and clone them with one click. Cloned agents never inherit API keys — security is preserved by design.
LandingPage.faq4Question: Can I share my agents with others?
LandingPage.featureAgentFactoryDesc: Build agents visually with drag-and-drop on a React Flow canvas. 5 agent types: Base, Sequential, Parallel, Loop, Router. Undo/redo, auto-layout, and real-time execution.
LandingPage.featureAiInActionDesc: Chat with your agents in real-time. Streaming responses, code artifacts with execution, voice input, file uploads, conversation branches, and multi-session management.
LandingPage.featureBiReportingDesc: Create interactive dashboards with bar, line, and pie charts. Upload CSV data or connect to server-side queries. Auto-refresh, drag-and-drop layout, and shareable reports.
LandingPage.featureIntegrationsDesc: Connect GitHub, Google (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar), and Microsoft (Outlook). OAuth-secured tokens let agents act on external services.
LandingPage.featureKnowledgeRagDesc: Upload PDFs, CSVs, connect databases or S3 buckets. Agents search and reason over your documents with vector-powered RAG. Includes Text-to-SQL for natural language database queries.
LandingPage.featureMarketplaceDesc: Publish your agents to the community hub. Discover and clone agents with one click. Security by design — cloned agents never inherit API keys.
LandingPage.featureOrchestratorDesc: Schedule agents with cron expressions or run on-demand. Monitor execution in real-time with status tracking, logs, and the ability to cancel running jobs.
LandingPage.featureSecurityAuthDesc: Multi-factor authentication (TOTP), OAuth SSO via Google, GitHub, and Microsoft. AES-encrypted API keys, guardrails with blocked terms and tools, output schema validation.
LandingPage.featuresSubtitle: A single platform to build, run and supervise agents — from the canvas to production.
LandingPage.featureToolBoxDesc: 50+ pre-built tools — RAG search, web scraping, SQL, email, APIs. Create custom tool configurations. Organize by categories with full parameter inspection.
LandingPage.finalCtaSubtitle: Start building, orchestrating and supervising agents — in minutes, not months.
LandingPage.finalCtaTrustLine: Free to start · No credit card required
LandingPage.footerTagline: Build, orchestrate and supervise AI agents. By thaink².
LandingPage.heroSubtitle: Design, orchestrate and supervise autonomous AI agents — from idea to production in minutes. No code required.
LandingPage.heroTrustLine: Free to start · No credit card required · OAuth SSO included
LandingPage.integrationsSubtitle: Connect third-party services via OAuth. Agents read, write, and act on external platforms securely.
LandingPage.showcaseBuilderDesc: Drag agents onto a React Flow canvas. Connect them into sequential, parallel, loop, or routing flows. Configure each agent with natural language instructions, select from 10+ LLM providers, attach tools — all without writing a single line of code. Undo/redo, auto-layout, and context menus included.
LandingPage.showcaseBuilderTitle:
Design agents like
you design workflows
LandingPage.showcaseIntegrationsDesc: Connect Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Sheets, Calendar, GitHub, and Microsoft Outlook. Schedule agents with cron expressions — every 5 minutes, hourly, daily, or custom. Monitor every run with real-time status, logs, and cancellation.

in the real world
